items.title: F5, Braze, CrowdStrike, MongoDB, and Cloudflare Shares Plummet, What You Need To Know
items.summary: Shares of F5, Braze, CrowdStrike, MongoDB, and Cloudflare plummeted due to escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and rising global bond yields, which dampened investor risk appetite and revived inflation concerns. These factors, combined with the growing likelihood of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike, led to broad-based selling across equity indices. Despite the market downturn, analysts suggest that significant price drops can present buying opportunities for high-quality stocks.

items.title: Union Pacific (UNP) Q1 2026 Earnings: Results, Market Reaction & History
items.summary: Union Pacific (UNP) reported strong Q1 2026 earnings, with adjusted diluted EPS of $2.93 beating estimates and revenue reaching $6.22 billion, exceeding expectations. The company highlighted significant operational improvements, including a record terminal dwell time and increased fuel efficiency, contributing to a 5% rise in net income. Management affirmed its 2026 outlook for mid-single digit EPS growth, expecting pricing to outpace inflation despite a muted economic forecast.

items.title: Gap Sales Surge as Old Navy Reshapes Canadian Store Network
items.summary: Gap Inc. is experiencing varied performance across its brands, with Gap comparable sales up 10% while Old Navy saw a 4% decline due to issues with women's summer merchandise and pricing. Old Navy is actively adjusting its Canadian store network, closing some prominent locations while opening new ones and investing in initiatives like Old Navy Sport and Old Navy Beauty Co. The company is also undergoing a leadership change at Old Navy and expects overall sales and profit growth for the year.

items.title: Dollar stores benefit as shoppers remain under pressure
items.summary: Dollar General and Dollar Tree are experiencing strong sales growth, particularly in consumable products, as consumers face economic pressures and seek value. Both companies reported increased sales of consumables and noted that shoppers are gravitating towards their low-priced assortments. Dollar General is also seeing success with its $1 frozen food program and attracting higher-income shoppers, while Dollar Tree emphasizes the strong performance of both its consumable and discretionary categories.

items.title: VICI Properties (VICI) Q3 2025 Earnings: Results, Market Reaction & History
items.summary: VICI Properties reported strong Q3 2025 earnings, beating Wall Street expectations with diluted EPS of $0.71 and total revenues of $1.01 billion, driven by contractual rent escalators and 100% occupancy. The company also announced its eighth consecutive annual dividend increase and raised its full-year 2025 AFFO guidance, reflecting confidence in its long-term lease structure. Key drivers included 4.4% year-over-year revenue growth and 5.3% year-over-year AFFO per share growth, with a weighted average lease term of 40 years across its 93 experiential properties.

items.title: Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd. (NYSE:RCL) Plans $1.50 Quarterly Dividend
items.summary: Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd. (NYSE:RCL) announced a quarterly dividend of $1.50 per share, payable on October 8th to shareholders of record by September 17th. This dividend annualizes to $6.00 per share, representing a 2.2% yield, and is well-covered by the company's earnings with a payout ratio of 33.9%. Analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating for RCL, with an average price target of $353.40.

items.title: Time to start fading Caterpillar stock, says trader Tony Zhang
items.summary: Trader Tony Zhang suggests that it's time to "fade" Caterpillar (CAT) stock, citing its recent 30% drop from summer highs, a break below the $800 support level, and weakening relative strength. He notes that Wall Street analysts are re-evaluating the AI power narrative that previously drove the stock, and a large options bet has been placed on further downside. Zhang recommends a bearish put spread strategy to capitalize on a potential move towards the $700 support level.

items.title: Animal Health Is at the Center of Society's Most Important Trends
items.summary: Elanco Animal Health, guided by its belief in "Food and Companionship Enriching Life," emphasizes the growing importance of animal health in addressing global trends such as increasing protein consumption, pet integration into families, and sustainable food production. The company's business strategy is deeply integrated with environmental, social, and governance (ESG) priorities, focusing on innovation and access to care for animals, economic value for customers, contributions to society, and fostering a strong internal culture. This approach aims to create meaningful societal value, making animal health an essential industry for a healthier and more sustainable future.

items.title: Ford US sales drop 10% in August, as F-Series starts restock
items.summary: Ford Motor Co.'s U.S. sales declined by 10.3% year-over-year in August, primarily due to decreases in daily rental and fleet sales and the discontinuation of some models for EV retooling. Despite the overall drop, retail share increased, driven by strong performance from models like Maverick and Ranger. F-Series truck production is ramping up after supplier issues, with Ford aiming to restock dealer inventory to 50-60 days of supply and maintain strong pricing.
